steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Good news, Doctor.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi has approved Rhodes Island's applications. 'It's necessary for our valued partners to visit the city.'

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: If none of these things happened in the first place, you would've been able to enjoy the Grand Knight Territory more freely.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, were you looking for me?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh, Gravel! I still have some healthy food leftovers. Want to take them with you?

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Good day, Gravel, Doctor.

options: We rarely get a chance to visit the other parts of Kazimierz.
Want to take a look around?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Wh-What a battle! I can hardly believe my eyes!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Actually, I should be talking our unknown Nightzmora! Can you believe this is his first Major appearance, and he's holding his own against a champion?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The clash of blood-red armor on the field tonight will eclipse the moon!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The audience is definitely feeling it too! Tola, 'Scourge of the Prairie,' Nightmare Knight! His crazed determination is addictive and intoxicating!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Nightmare Knight's been surging in the polls since his duel with the Radiant Knight! Will he add another page to this story?! A rise to grand knighthood?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: By the way, Ancients Entertainment is holding a 'Knightly Title Trivia Game!' Guess the knightly titles and win fabulous prizes!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Where'd your bravado go, Nightzmora?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Ngh...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Minoan, in the times when my ancestors flayed the land, your heroes had all become naught but words on the lips of poets.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You waste your breath.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Where's your Khagan now? What happened to those proud kinsmen of yours?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: One who lives in a bygone nightmare is a pitiful man indeed.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Minoan, Infected. What are you fighting for?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Survival.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: They made me the hero of the Infected... They enshrined me in the annals of history. But I just wanted to survive.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: The hero of the Infected?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I see... Do you not also fight for your people?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: My people...? No. We don't share the same bloodline, nor were we born in the same place. We are just unfortunate enough to suffer the same disease.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: I pitied their plight, so I went to deliver them, to find a way out for them.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You say they're not your people... But you still want to save them...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Laughable.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You are mighty, without a doubt. But, have the prairies of Kazimierz been carved up by the Infected and foreigners?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: The Kazimierzians, the Kuranta... Where are they?!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Did I cross thousands of miles to the country of knights, only to fight against the Infected, Minoans, and my own kinsmen?!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ––A sick joke!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Woaaaahh... S-So, this is Kazimierz's commercial hub?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Strictly speaking, this is just one of hundreds of commercial centers across the Grand Knight Territory.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: I recommended this particular one because it's close.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But there's way too much junk food everywhere! Just one look around and I count three popcorn stands, two pizzerias, and four burger shops!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: This is unacceptable!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Haha... Is this because there's a competition venue nearby?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Of course. The arena lies at the heart of every center of commerce.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: All businesses revolve around the knights' glorious blood sport. It's the way things are done here.

steps.name: Nightingale
steps.text: Is this... a Nearl doll?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Aww! It's so cute!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wait a minute, this shop... Is it all dedicated to...

steps.name: A Shopkeeper
steps.text: Yo! Are you folks fans of the Radiant Knight too?

steps.name: A Shopkeeper
steps.text: Then, you've come to the right place! This is a specialty store for everything Radiant Knight! Clay figurines, plush dolls, Nearl family crests – you name it, we've got it!

steps.name: A Shopkeeper
steps.text: By the way, if the Radiant Knight manages to defeat the Wind Knight and advance to the finals, our supplier is considering making exclusive commemorative medals from refined Originium! Want to put in a pre-order?

steps.name: A Shopkeeper
steps.text: I mean, the Radiant Knight's pretty much sure to win! Hahaha!

options: (Rhetorically ask if the store would consider a shield used by the Radiant Knight its greatest treasure.)

steps.name: A Shopkeeper
steps.text: Thanks for your patronage!

steps.name: A Shopkeeper
steps.text: Oh, uh... You only have foreign money? Lungmen Dollars? Err, you'll have to go to the bank first.

steps.name: A Shopkeeper
steps.text: Let me do the conversion for you real quick... That should be about 1.3 million LMD?

steps.name: A Shopkeeper
steps.text: A shield? Since when did the Radiant Knight use a shield?

steps.name: A Shopkeeper
steps.text: But we have warhammers, double-bladed swords, and even the latest model of swordspears. Want to take a look?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It's hard to tell what's going on! Nightmare Knight's ferocious attack was again repelled by the Blood Knight, and the former champion is slicing through the artificial turf as if it was tofu!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It's already been ten minutes, but the tempestuous exchange of blows continues! Who will be the first to show signs of fatigue in this seemingly endless battle?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ––As I speak, the champion is readying his Arts again! He evades a sweeping strike from his opponent!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: After all that, are the two sides only feeling each other out?! Neither the champion nor the Nightzmora seems to want to take the initiative and cast the first Arts––

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Minoan, how did you learn to fight like this?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Unfortunately, I had very little combat training before becoming a knight.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: It was only after that I learned as I fought.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ...A born warrior.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Young man.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: I am not your mentor. But, if it is an opponent you seek, there is one thing I can teach you.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: The fear you seek to instill through bluffing means nothing to someone who lives only in the present.
The Blood Knight takes a half-step back.
Fresh blood oozes from his armor, condensing into a stream around him.
A crimson light wraps around his weapon, forging it into a lethal edge of judgment.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Answer me, Nightzmora. In the history you dreamt, in the thousands of years between then and now––

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Were the Infected ever given a new lease on life?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Why you...

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You call yourself a Kheshig? Then don't back down now, Nightzmora!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Where is your Khagan now? Bring him to me!

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: Where is your Khagan?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Where is your Khagan?
Thousands of years have passed since the Khagan stepped into history.
You'll only find him in history books, boy.
Kheshigs? They were the Khagan's attendants, the greatest warriors known to this world.
The Khagan conquered many places, but in doing so, did a lot of things that hurt people.
It is in the nature of the Nightzmora to spread fear, and the desire to conquer was practically sustenance for the Khagan.
But, Tola.
You were born into this world, and you will surely find your own––

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ...Father, rival, master, ideals.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Was I actually... looking for these things in this city?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: No! It is time to wake up from my dream.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: This will just be a lingering memory. The path I drew for my Khaganquest was set in stone a long time ago.

a.text: The young hunter sets out on his Khaganquest ♪
From dreams he goes, towards the shores of gold ♪
A Nightzmora stands in the arena.
His limbs are at ease. His flaws are exposed. He knows not where to cast his gaze from beneath that helmet.
Until the black night paints over his vision ♪ Until a tower of bone stands erect in his heart ♪
Until hemlock chokes his hazy home ♪

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Done saying your prayers?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: My family is dead. My people are lost.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ––The Khagan is wherever the tip of my blade points.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ––am my own Khagan!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Come!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Clear weather. No wind. A fine day for shooting.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Targets: the two leaders of Rhodes Island - one hooded person of unknown race, and one Cautus.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Mood... Very bad. Because every time I try to do my work, someone gets in my way.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Addendum. Extremely bad mood.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Do you have a habit of keeping a diary?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Who would deliberately write these things down? Might as well send it to the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz and ask for a speedier sentence.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: By the looks of things, you're the type of person who brings her baggage with her to work.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Confessarius, the Radiant Knight, and that Cautus who gives off strange vibes.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: What the hell is Rhodes Island supposed to be anyway?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I never had a chance to ask you before, but... You people...

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Where did you hear the name 'Confessarius'?
Monique has seen the skills of the Sarkaz before her.
Excellent swordsmanship. Complex, seemingly incomprehensible Originium Arts - perhaps witchcraft. Along with the Radiant Knight, she was able to block a Darksteel arrow.
She had a suspicion at the time, that perhaps... 'blocking arrows' was not the full extent of the Sarkaz's abilities.
But now, she is convinced of one thing.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: ...I can't tell you that.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I'm also not so kind-hearted that I can just watch an assassin take aim at the Doctor and Amiya, and then let her walk free.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Besides, the last time we met, we didn't get a chance to introduce ourselves properly. A bit rude on both our parts.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: An aura...?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Why are all of the Radiant Knight's buddies so shiny and sparkly? I'm getting tired of that aesthetic.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: (It's a comforting glow... Almost no hints of aggression... Is this Sarkaz witchcraft?)

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: (Her expression... Does she lament drawing her sword?)

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Not in the mood to chat?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Very well then. Let's find out just what you're worth.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Wh-What just happened...?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Are my eyes playing tricks on me? A black mist is rising from the arena – While that isn't too unusual, do you see something rising from the mist?

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Is that... a banner? Wait, that's... an entire army?!

steps.name: The Radiant Knight
steps.text: Is that... the product of your obsession?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: A shame...

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: A shame that those knights watching from the stands cannot fathom how I how I feel right now.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: The flag flutters, the horn sounds, an army marches... An entire people, an entire history.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: But––

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ––is this the reason you've given up the present, to seek out death like a madman?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ––Hraaaagh!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Nightzmora knight launched an attack! B-But with the thick black mist enveloping the arena, I can't see what's going on!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Is that something charging forward inside the mist?! Is this Nightmare Knight's true Arts? The ability to summon his ancestors?!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Ridiculous.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You lack the courage to face your fate.
The Blood Knight brings down his axe. He knows he is not facing an ancient Kheshig army.
A young man who seeks his own annihilation.
A young man who tries to bring back a bygone era.
The jet-black mist drowns the sanguine armor of the Blood Knight.
From the impact, from the pain, it is clear that the summoned entities are not illusions or holograms.
The Blood Knight continues to stand motionless. He is waiting. Waiting for the moment when the real Nightzmora will strike.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (Ancient language) Sleep now, hero!
The Blood Knight lets out a grunt.
Even Kazimierz's strongest armor wails in this moment.
Blade cleaves through armor, and even the sturdy Blood Knight is almost forced to take a knee.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Damn... Only a flesh wound?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You were able to cut me.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: But my blood is now on your weapon.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: (A trap––?!)

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Don't feel bad. Your lack of combat experience has always been your weakness.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: You are still a far cry from the so-called 'Kheshig.'

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: The sight of you and the Radiant Knight blocking Darksteel's arrow made a deep impression. Even a Silverlance Pegasus would have trouble withstanding Darksteel's punishment.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: My sources tell me you and the Radiant Knight call yourselves the 'Followers,' an organization that treats the Infected.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: A 'physician,' huh? Looks like I need to toss that informant of mine into the gloompincer cage.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Unfortunately, I'm not fond of fighting.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I used to be in the Victorian army.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Because I was just a commoner without noble blood, I couldn't become an officer. The K.G.C.C. ended up poaching me during a joint military exercise.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: At that time, my old bosses were still rejoicing over one fewer thorn in their sides.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: So, I'm quite confident in my aim.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: From this distance, take three of my arrows head on, and I'll drop my plans for Rhodes Island. Deal?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Why should I trust you?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Whether or not you do is up to you. The Armorless Union has no shortage of ways to deal with Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: For example, we could've applied some volatile chemicals to those dolls that they're clutching so unsuspectingly right now...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Don't give me that look. Anyone could arrange something like that.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Three shots.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Three shots.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: (Exhales) ...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Number one.
Monique draws her bowstring. A picture-perfect Victorian form.
Back in her military days, the young Monique could pierce a willow branch at a hundred paces. She was famous for it.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Didn't draw enough for that one.
The Sarkaz before her didn't even draw her sword.
The unexpected result sends a stifling heat through Monique's chest, the unwanted sensation rushes toward her heart.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Number two.
She draws her bow taut a second time.
On a rainy night, Monique once attacked a first-order campaign knight.
The opponent was not some famous hero, but a true veteran of the Ursus-Kazimierz War.
His quick reflexes spared him the arrow from the darkness, and the two ended up locked in combat until they plunged off a cliff.
The forests of Kazimierz were cold and steep in the early spring, and the chase through the dense woods lasted seven days and nights.
At the moment when the pain in her limbs and the ringing in her ears were almost intolerable, she drew her bowstring back and nocked her arrow once more, finding her target as he stopped for water.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Her stance changed, as has the look in her eyes.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Like a hunter, waiting for an opening.
The arrow split in two in midair.
One segment embedded itself into the ground. The other disappeared into a grassy clearing, where it startled a few chattering fowlbeasts.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: But I have no intention of becoming your prey.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Are all Confessarii all as skilled with the sword as you?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Or rather, are there a lot of other people at Rhodes Island like you?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: (Should we redo Rhodes Island's risk assessment?)

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: To be honest, getting rid of Rhodes Island should be the responsibility of the Board.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: But soon enough, I won't be acting on their orders.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You don't believe me?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: No... Actually, that doesn't come as a surprise.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Our leader has also foreseen this possibility.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: So what's the point of you saying this? That this duel is solely a matter of your pride?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: The point is... You should give this everything you've got, Sarkaz.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Last one.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: ...Nngh!

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: It's over.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: A stunning reversal! In a single heavy blow, the Blood Knight has dissipated the heavy mist lingering in the arena!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: His momentum sweeps right through Nightmare Knight's illusions!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Too bad for you, Nightzmora! You made one miscalculation! In the face of the Blood Knight and his mastery of Blood Arts, you underestimated his skills in a melee!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Was that really an illusion? It seemed like... an entire war.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Graaaah.... Ahhhhh! Arrrrrrghh!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What?! Even after taking that tremendous blow at point-blank range, Nightmare Knight is still standing?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Unbelievable! Could he be mustering a counterattack–?

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: ––As the Blood Knight, I would like to put in a request to speak with the judges.

steps.name: The Blood Knight
steps.text: Yes, he has lost his senses. Should we continue this, his life will be in danger. Let's call this match.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: ––The judges have reached a verdict! Without a doubt, the first knight to advance to the finals of the Major has been decided!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The clash between the Nightzmora and the champion has ended! A battle between fear and terror incarnate! I have the results right here––!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It is my great honor to announce the winner of tonight's round––
Before Mob can finish announcing the winner's name, from behind a conspicuous barrier in the corner of the arena....
A certain Infected knight stands up.

steps.name: An Infected Knight A
steps.text: The Blood Knight!

steps.name: An Infected Knight B
steps.text: The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: They're all... Infected?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: The Blood Knight has won! Long live the Blood Knight!

steps.name: A Spectating Infected
steps.text: The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!

steps.name: A Spectating Infected
steps.text: The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!

a.text: The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!
The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!

steps.text: The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!
The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!
The Blood Knight slowly lifts his hand and gestures to the audience.
He then turns his head to look at the Nightzmora who has still not fallen.
As the Blood Knight lifts his eyes above the Nightzmora, his gaze meets that of another knight in the distance.
The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: (The professional thing would be to not interrupt the audience when they're in an uproar, but most of them seem like they're Infected... so maybe it's fine?)

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: This is the hero of Kazimierz's Infected, Margaret.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: You strive to fulfill a similar role. How will you deal with this overlap?

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!

steps.name: Ioleta Russell
steps.text: This is the Infected... Dikaiopolis.

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight!

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: So that's the hero, the Blood Knight. So much fanfare for that name.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Though the Radiant Knight is a paragon of defiance, the one who truly managed to carve out a space for the Infected... is the Blood Knight, Dikaiopolis.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: But... it has been a long time since he bowed his head to us.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: In my capacity as a media man, I deeply appreciate your proposal, Mr. Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But as you know, this... public opinion, is just a thin layer of assurance. To make sure things go smoothly, we'll have to prepare to play hardball.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I just don't want everyone to end up... with no way back.

steps.name: An Enthusiastic Spectator
steps.text: The Blood Knight! The Blood Knight won!

steps.name: An Enthusiastic Spectator
steps.text: Ahaha! I knew the Blood Knight was invincible! Nobody can take him down!

steps.name: An Enthusiastic Spectator
steps.text: Oh, what's going on over there?

steps.name: An Enthusiastic Spectator
steps.text: The roof over there... is it sunrise?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You—
The Sarkaz slowly closes her eyes, as if refusing to view her Arts.
A brief brilliance lingers on the tip of her sword, like the setting sun.
As if she suddenly remembered something, the Sarkaz quickly changes her pose, bringing the sword into her embrace.
As if this sword never should be unsheathed.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: What... did you do just now...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Was that Sarkaz witchcraft? No, what I felt just now was...
The breath of life? No. A soul's lifeforce? No.
It was more like a formless illusion, something that could only be touched while in a trance or a drunken stupor.
But there is no doubt that just now, the Sarkaz... was wielding the twilight.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Grr...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: That technique... You...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You could've killed me!

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I was just taking your three shots, Armorless.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Of course, if you go back on your word, I will.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You—
The feeling of being caught.
She can't run. She would be chased down... But by what? By that Sarkaz? Or her sword?
Or by the thing she controls... the essence of life?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Do you want to continue?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Even on the job, we still fulfill our obligations.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Pull out. Stop tailing Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I have one more, kind of trivial question for you.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: I'll consider it, out of respect for you keeping your word.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: For you Sarkaz, is there some kind of significance... to cutting off your horns?

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It differs from person to person. Some may see their Sarkaz heritage as a curse, and may do that as a way of trying to hide their identity.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: It might also be a way to channel a certain form of witchcraft, to a facilitate a certain Arts.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Or perhaps... it might even be a tradition of some unconventional tribes. The possibilities are many, and there's no way to say for sure.

steps.name: Shining
steps.text: Why do you ask?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: ...No, no reason.
